papers.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
papers.tldr: Edge0 enables efficient mixture-of-experts inference on consumer hardware by predicting expert routing ahead of time and using recovery adapters to maintain quality with minimal active memory.

papers.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
papers.tldr: A multi-agent framework using large language models for stock trading simulates real-world trading firms, improving performance metrics like cumulative returns and Sharpe ratio.

papers.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
papers.tldr: TokenEconomizer reduces recurring token costs of coding agents across sequential real-world tasks by pruning irrelevant tools, injecting micro-skills, and interrupting failure loops.

papers.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
papers.tldr: Harness² improves agent execution harnesses through recursive task-level refinement and continual harness-level learning, boosting performance across benchmarks without ground-truth verifiers.

papers.title: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
papers.tldr: LingBot-Touch is a tactile foundation model that learns a unified, extensible representation across heterogeneous tactile sensors, yielding plug-and-play tactile tokens that consistently enhance manipulation policies such as diffusion policy and VLA models.

papers.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
papers.tldr: MACaQ is an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that quantizes each linear layer independently using online activation transforms and Hessian-aware refinement, reducing cost while preserving accuracy across language and diffusion models.

papers.title: e-means: outperforming k-means (in one-tenth the epochs)
papers.tldr: Lloyd's k-means algorithm is a long-running standard for clustering, with applications in data analysis, retrieval, quantization and data curation.

papers.title: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
papers.tldr: Kronos, a specialized pre-training framework for financial K-line data, outperforms existing models in forecasting and synthetic data generation through a unique tokenizer and autoregressive pre-training on a large dataset.

papers.title: VibeVoice Technical Report
papers.tldr: VibeVoice synthesizes long-form multi-speaker speech using next-token diffusion and a highly efficient continuous speech tokenizer, achieving superior performance and fidelity.

papers.title: OpenDevin: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
papers.tldr: OpenDevin is a platform for developing AI agents that interact with the world by writing code, using command lines, and browsing the web, with support for multiple agents and evaluation benchmarks.

papers.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
papers.tldr: PagedAttention algorithm and vLLM system enhance the throughput of large language models by efficiently managing memory and reducing waste in the key-value cache.

papers.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.tldr: A decision model that acts poorly can still teach reinforcement learning policies effectively by judging complete action trajectories, improving success on ALFWorld and WebShop.

papers.title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
papers.tldr: FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts serving system that dynamically maps computation and model state onto heterogeneous local hardware to run large open-weight models on personal machines.

papers.title: Very Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation in AgentScope
papers.tldr: Enhancements to the AgentScope platform improve scalability, efficiency, and ease of use for large-scale multi-agent simulations through distributed mechanisms, flexible environments, and user-friendly tools.

papers.title: AgentScope 1.0: A Developer-Centric Framework for Building Agentic Applications
papers.tldr: AgentScope enhances agentic applications by providing flexible tool-based interactions, unified interfaces, and advanced infrastructure based on the ReAct paradigm, supporting efficient and safe development and deployment.

papers.title: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
papers.tldr: OmniEdu is a family of instruction-tuned educational foundation models that improve K-12 problem solving, curriculum understanding, and tutoring through capability-balanced training data.

papers.title: MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient High-Resolution Document Parsing
papers.tldr: MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language model, achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy with computational efficiency through a coarse-to-fine parsing strategy.

papers.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
papers.tldr: Flide is an exact inference engine that accelerates decision-model LLM agents by decoupling logical request trees from physical execution and using ForkAttention to preserve exact branch evaluations.

papers.title: HuggingFace's Transformers: State-of-the-art Natural Language Processing
papers.tldr: Transformers library provides state-of-the-art Transformer architectures and pretrained models for natural language processing tasks with a unified API and emphasis on extensibility and robust deployment.

papers.title: ARIS: Autonomous Research via Adversarial Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.tldr: ARIS is an open-source research harness that uses cross-model adversarial collaboration to ensure reliable long-term research outcomes through coordinated execution, orchestration, and assurance layers.
